About this item

  • Designed With Pros, Engineered to Win: Designed alongside the world’s best esports athletes, the Logitech G PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE wireless gaming mouse delivers the fastest, fully customizable click
  • Dominate with industry-leading speed: 30 ms faster clicks for peak performance in every esports match and deep customization with 10-level actuation points and 5-level rapid trigger reset
  • Haptic Feedback: This breakthrough haptic gaming mouse with Haptic Inductive Trigger System (HITS) gives real-time feedback for an unmatched immersive experience for any game scenario or play style
  • Precision from Within: The HERO 2 sensor in this PC gaming mouse delivers tracking at over 888 IPS, 88 g-force, and up to 44,000 DPI — ensuring the pinpoint accuracy that champions rely on for every play
  • Play Longer : With 60-90 hours battery life and LIGHTSPEED Wireless, this rechargeable gaming mouse(with included USB-A to USB-C cable) delivers lag-free 8 kHz polling for uninterrupted focus
  • Ultra-durable, this lightweight mouse is built with 0.7 mm thin-wall case and extra-large gliding UHMWPE feet for effortless movement
  • PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE is compatible with PC and Mac; POWERPLAY 2 enabled for endless wireless play—no interruptions or charging worries
  • (1) Advanced features require Logitech G HUB Software; polling performance tested on G640 mousepad; (2) POWERPLAY sold separately

Product Description

Logitech G partnered with top esports athletes to create The Fastest, Fully Customizable Click. Equipped with the Haptic Inductive Trigger System, the advanced HERO 2 sensor, and the robust LIGHTSPEED wireless. PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE is a revolutionary PRO mouse delivering The Winning Click. Customize each main key’s actuation point, rapid trigger setting and click haptics. Your competition won’t know what hit them.

From the manufacturer

YOUR NEW FAVORITE WEAPON

PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE replaces microswitches with new tech for ultra-low click latency. Customize each main key’s actuation point, rapid trigger setting & click haptics. Your competition won’t know what hit them.

HAPTIC INDUCTIVE TRIGGER SYSTEM (HITS)

Milliseconds matter when the win is on the line. Our breakthrough Haptic Inductive Trigger System replaces traditional microswitches, reducing click latency by up to 30 ms for phenomenally faster targeting.

TUNABLE ACUATION & RESET POINTS

Optimize each main key click travel distance with micrometer precision between ten actuation points and five rapid trigger reset values. Save milliseconds with every click compared to all other gaming mice.

PRECISE CLICK HAPTICS

Only feel what you need to. Custom hardware syncs with inductive sensing systems to generate tactile feedback on every click. Six intensity options for both main keys offer customized click experiences.

DESIGNED WITH PROS

Our gear is developed with over 100 of the world’s greatest esports athletes — from NAVI, G2, GEN.G, FlyQuest RED, and others. G2 won VCT Americas Stage 2 on a SUPERSTRIKE prototype. Just saying.

Previous page

  1. PINNACLE OF PERFORMANCE

    Unleash champion-level precision with the HERO 2 sensor—ultra-fast tracking and high DPI for peak gaming performance and control.

  2. ICONIC SHAPE & PROVEN FEEL

    Play longer, play better. PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE’s iconic, balanced design combines comfort and advanced tech for unstoppable gaming.

  3. PLAY AT LIGHTSPEED

    LIGHTSPEED wireless gives you up to 8kHz polling—experience wired-like speed and rock-solid reliability, even in intense esports settings.

  4. G HUB CUSTOMIZATION & PROFILES

    Set actuation, rapid trigger, and haptics, all POWERED BY G HUB. Save to mouse memory for instant, on-the-go performance in every game.

  5. UNPLUG & LOCK IN

    Get up to 90 h of battery life on a single charge. Quickly recharge with USB-C, or with POWERPLAY 2 (sold separately) for wireless freedom.

    5 out of 5 stars
    The best gaming mouse I’ve ever used
    I’ve owned and tested many gaming mice over the years, and the Logitech G Superstrike X2 is, without question, the best one I’ve ever used. I don’t play competitively—I mostly enjoy adventure games, action titles, and other immersive experiences—but this mouse has made every gaming session more enjoyable. It combines incredible comfort, premium build quality, and features that genuinely stand out. The biggest highlight for me is the haptic switches. They feel amazing, providing a tactile, satisfying click that makes every input feel deliberate and precise. The feedback is unlike anything I’ve experienced on another mouse, adding a level of immersion that you don’t realize you’re missing until you try it. Combined with the outstanding responsiveness, every click feels fast, consistent, and incredibly satisfying. Another thing I absolutely love is how lightweight it is. It glides effortlessly across the mousepad and never feels fatiguing, even after hours of gaming. The shape is comfortable, the weight is perfectly balanced, and it almost feels like an extension of your hand. The wireless connectivity has also been flawless. It’s fast, stable, and completely reliable, with no noticeable latency or dropouts. It truly delivers the freedom of wireless without any of the compromises that used to come with it. Logitech has once again delivered a premium product. From the build quality to the innovative haptic switches, lightweight design, and rock-solid wireless performance, everything about the Superstrike X2 feels refined and thoughtfully engineered. It’s a mouse that makes you appreciate the little details every time you use it. Overall, this is easily the best mouse I’ve ever owned, and I couldn’t recommend it more. Whether you’re a competitive player or, like me, simply want the best possible experience while enjoying your favorite games, the Logitech Superstrike X2 is absolutely worth it.

      Best Mouse I’ve Ever Used
      Reviewed in the United States on February 15, 2026
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I’ve had this mouse for almost a week now, and I can confidently say it’s hands down the best mouse I’ve ever used. It’s incredibly lightweight, the wireless performance has been flawless, and it just feels high quality overall.

      I am 35 years old and don't have the best reaction time but this mouse dropped my Human Benchmark reaction time average from 190 ms to around 160 ms. I wasn’t even planning on testing this, but one of my friends told me to try it and see if there was actually a difference. I tested on my old mouse, a Model O, and then back to the Superstrike X2 just to make sure it wasn’t in my head. The difference was still there. Everything just feels quicker and more in control, and the speed and click feel really make a difference.

      The feeling when you click it is incredibly responsive and smooth. The only thing I can compare it to is clicking an iPhone sleep button.

      Battery life has been very good also. After about six hours of gameplay, the battery only went from 82% down to 75%, which is impressive for a wireless gaming mouse.

      Can't recommend this mouse enough to everyone

      I’ve owned and tested many gaming mice over the years, and the Logitech G Superstrike X2 is, without question, the best one I’ve ever used. I don’t play competitively—I mostly enjoy adventure games, action titles, and other immersive experiences—but this mouse has made every gaming session more enjoyable. It combines incredible comfort, premium build quality, and features that genuinely stand out.

      The biggest highlight for me is the haptic switches. They feel amazing, providing a tactile, satisfying click that makes every input feel deliberate and precise. The feedback is unlike anything I’ve experienced on another mouse, adding a level of immersion that you don’t realize you’re missing until you try it. Combined with the outstanding responsiveness, every click feels fast, consistent, and incredibly satisfying.

      Another thing I absolutely love is how lightweight it is. It glides effortlessly across the mousepad and never feels fatiguing, even after hours of gaming. The shape is comfortable, the weight is perfectly balanced, and it almost feels like an extension of your hand.

      The wireless connectivity has also been flawless. It’s fast, stable, and completely reliable, with no noticeable latency or dropouts. It truly delivers the freedom of wireless without any of the compromises that used to come with it.

      Logitech has once again delivered a premium product. From the build quality to the innovative haptic switches, lightweight design, and rock-solid wireless performance, everything about the Superstrike X2 feels refined and thoughtfully engineered. It’s a mouse that makes you appreciate the little details every time you use it.

      Overall, this is easily the best mouse I’ve ever owned, and I couldn’t recommend it more. Whether you’re a competitive player or, like me, simply want the best possible experience while enjoying your favorite games, the Logitech Superstrike X2 is absolutely worth it.

      Reviewed in the United States on May 8, 2026

      I gave this mouse 5 stars simply because of the haptic triggers. Ive only ever used the razer viper pro mouse and for my large hands its the only one that fits comfortably. The superstrike is a bit smaller in my hand but nothing that would make me stop using it. Its heavier than the razer and to my surprise I actually like and prefer that. The battery life on the mouse is great. The settings you choose for the haptic triggers does affect battery life but its nothing major. Now the main reason I bought this mouse was for the haptic system it uses and ill be blunt and say its the best thing ever and I hope more companies adapt this. Being able to adjust the actuation points is fantastic. It will take a few days to get used to the sensitivity if you go all the way to one but once youre used to it you'll never want a regular mouse again. Overall I think its a fantastic mouse its a bit spendy but in my opinion the haptic system by itself is worth the price. The only issue i have with this mouse is the side buttons they are extremely squishy they barely click its very unsatisfying I would give the side buttons a half a star.

    • Dev E.
      4 out of 5 stars
      Amazing feel and customizability, but I would like more features
      Reviewed in the United States on July 19, 2026
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I tried this mouse out because I have frequent fingertip sensitivity and pain in my left index finger after long clicking sessions. At its lowest setting, its easier to click than an average mouse, and the haptic feedback feels very nice. When I switch back to a regular mouse such as the G502X Plus, I can notice a difference in force required to click the mouse and weight of the mouse. However, the scroll wheel on this one is not MagSpeed like other Logitech mice such as MX Masters and G502Xs. This would have been a nice addition as that type of scroll wheel also helps with my fingertip sensitivity.

      I also really like how lightweight this mouse is. It's very easy to move around and pick up.

      Overall an excellent mouse, but if I could have Logitech design my dream mouse which I'd pay $250+ for, I would just ask for this:

      - The adjustable actuation point and haptic feel from this mouse

      - The smooth MagSpeed scroll wheel from the Logitech MX Master 4

      - The extra programmable buttons from the G502X Plus

      - And miscellaneous features such as quiet clicks for all buttons, RGB, 60g of weight or less, USB-C dongle as well as bluetooth options for wireless connection, and an extra programmable button on the right side where the pinky goes.

      These would really help with my fingertip sensitivity and would overall be the perfect mouse for me. I'm disappointed that no Logitech mouse has all these features as they are all amazing additions to a mouse. I hope this message can find someone at Logitech for them to design the perfect mouse. For now, I will be sticking with the G502X Plus as it has the smooth scroll wheel and the multiple programmable buttons.

      Loved up to hype, no issues, large improvment over my Razers
      Reviewed in the United States on August 25, 2026
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I am 37, my reaction times aren't what they used to be. I have been using the Razer DeathAdder v4 Pro and Razer Viper V4 Pro. This is a noticeable decrease in my reaction time. I saw a lot of videos talking about issues with missclicks from side squeezing....i have had none of that. It is a sturdy mouse, that is barely heavier than my Viper v4 Pro. The "front heavy" feel is highly overblown imo. I play R6 Siege and it is incredibly noticable on DMRs in particular. On the lowest sensitivity with Rapid Trigger, I can easily pop off 5 shots in the same time i used to get off 3. My click reaction time went from 205ms to 177ms on the click tester. And I have had no accidental shots, even on lowest sesnsitivity....as for the clicks themselves (the haptic feedback)...it feel soooo clean, crisp and is tunable to be more or less. I have been a Razer guy for over 20 years and the Superstrike finally offered something I couldnt refuse. It def lived up to the hype. Especially for someone who isnt a 19 year old with insane twitch fiber and eyesight. Give it a try

      Youll love it.

    • Alexander
      5 out of 5 stars
      Side buttons problem
      Reviewed in Canada on April 20, 2026
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I recently picked up this mouse as my first step into wireless gaming, specifically the Superstrike X2, after using a wired Razer Basilisk V3 for a long time. I’d been thinking about making the switch for a while, and overall I’m glad I did.

      The main buttons (left and right click) feel excellent — responsive, solid, and satisfying to use. This is clearly where the mouse shines, and it delivers exactly what you’d expect at this price point in terms of core performance.

      However, the side buttons (the two next to the left click area) are a noticeable weak point. They feel cheap and somewhat out of place, especially when compared to competitors like Razer. Considering the price of this mouse, I expected a higher-quality feel across all buttons, not just the main ones.

      That said, since the primary clicks and overall performance are what matter most in actual gameplay, I would still recommend this mouse. If you can overlook the side button quality, it’s a strong option for anyone looking to move into wireless gaming.

      Sorry for the messy mousepad :)

    About this Item

    • Designed With Pros, Engineered to Win: Designed alongside the world’s best esports athletes, the Logitech G PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE wireless gaming mouse delivers the fastest, fully customizable click
    • Dominate with industry-leading speed: 30 ms faster clicks for peak performance in every esports match and deep customization with 10-level actuation points and 5-level rapid trigger reset
    • Haptic Feedback: This breakthrough haptic gaming mouse with Haptic Inductive Trigger System (HITS) gives real-time feedback for an unmatched immersive experience for any game scenario or play style
    • Precision from Within: The HERO 2 sensor in this PC gaming mouse delivers tracking at over 888 IPS, 88 g-force, and up to 44,000 DPI — ensuring the pinpoint accuracy that champions rely on for every play
    • Play Longer : With 60-90 hours battery life and LIGHTSPEED Wireless, this rechargeable gaming mouse(with included USB-A to USB-C cable) delivers lag-free 8 kHz polling for uninterrupted focus
    • Ultra-durable, this lightweight mouse is built with 0.7 mm thin-wall case and extra-large gliding UHMWPE feet for effortless movement
    • PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE is compatible with PC and Mac; POWERPLAY 2 enabled for endless wireless play—no interruptions or charging worries
    • (1) Advanced features require Logitech G HUB Software; polling performance tested on G640 mousepad; (2) POWERPLAY sold separately

    Product Description

    Logitech G partnered with top esports athletes to create The Fastest, Fully Customizable Click. Equipped with the Haptic Inductive Trigger System, the advanced HERO 2 sensor, and the robust LIGHTSPEED wireless. PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE is a revolutionary PRO mouse delivering The Winning Click. Customize each main key’s actuation point, rapid trigger setting and click haptics. Your competition won’t know what hit them.
